content:
Here are some title options for the painting:

**Dramatic/Epic:**
- *"The Last Sentinel"*
- *"Blade of the Fallen Kingdom"*
- *"Guardian of the Ancient Realm"*

**Mysterious/Dark:**
- *"The Iron Oath"*
- *"Shadow of the Sworn Blade"*
- *"The Wandering Warden"*

**Noble/Heroic:**
- *"The Unyielding Champion"*
- *"Steel and Honor"*
- *"The Unbroken Vow"*

**My Top Recommendation:**

# *"The Iron Sentinel"*

This title captures the **strength**, **solitude**, and **epic fantasy essence** of the character while feeling timeless and powerful. It suits the full-body armored warrior standing alone with his sword perfectly.
